summary: Deployment-fix verification for Railway split-service (frontend Dockerfile + backend Dockerfile + root fallback). Static config validated, backend smoke tests green (/api/health 200, /api/auth/captcha 200 with base64 PNG + id, /api/auth/login rejects wrong captcha with 400), frontend login page loads on public URL with no console errors and captcha image renders. Production build succeeded (cd /app/frontend && CI=true yarn build) in ~22s and build dir was removed.

deployment_config_checks.frontend_dockerfile: OK - multi-stage node:20-alpine; COPY package.json yarn.lock; yarn install --frozen-lockfile; yarn build; serves ./build via serve@14 on tcp://0.0.0.0:${PORT}; ARG REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL propagated to build ENV.
deployment_config_checks.backend_dockerfile: OK - python:3.11-slim; installs backend/requirements.txt; CMD python run.py which reads PORT from env (no default -> fails fast).
deployment_config_checks.root_dockerfile: OK - references backend/requirements.txt and COPY backend/ . correctly (fallback build from repo root).
deployment_config_checks.railway_json_files: All three (frontend/railway.json, backend/railway.json, /railway.json) are valid JSON with builder=DOCKERFILE. Healthcheck paths: frontend=/, backend=/api/health.
deployment_config_checks.dockerignore: root .dockerignore excludes frontend/, memory/, test_reports/, tests/, .env* (keeps .env.example). frontend/.dockerignore excludes node_modules, build, .env*.
deployment_config_checks.backend_env_usage: server.py reads CORS_ORIGINS, MONGO_URL (via core), DB_NAME from env; no hardcoded values. run.py uses os.environ['PORT'] (raises if missing).
deployment_config_checks.frontend_env_usage: frontend/src only references process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (single location: src/lib/api.js). No hardcoded backend URLs.

backend_smoke_results.POST /api/auth/login (wrong captcha): 400 with Indonesian error message; UI surfaces same error text.

frontend_smoke_results.public_url_load: 200, title 'COMPLIANCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM Bank BPD Bali', root+static/js present
frontend_smoke_results.login_form: username input, password input, captcha input rendered; captcha PNG loaded via data URI (no CORS)
frontend_smoke_results.console_errors: None on initial load; only expected 400 network log after intentional wrong-captcha submit
frontend_smoke_results.wrong_captcha_ui: Error 'CAPTCHA salah atau kedaluwarsa. Masukkan kode yang baru.' shown to user

production_build: yarn build compiled successfully (main.js 278.2 kB gz, css 20.44 kB gz); build/ removed after verification.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/Dockerfile fixes PORT default to 3000; Railway will override via env - harmless. serve@14 pinned - good.
run.py deliberately uses os.environ['PORT'] with no fallback so misconfigured deploys fail fast - good.
Root Dockerfile + railway.json act as a safety net so a Railway service accidentally rooted at repo will still build backend (documented in SETUP.md).

backend/.env still has MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 and CORS_ORIGINS=* - fine for preview; ensure Railway backend service sets MONGO_URL=Atlas URI, DB_NAME, CORS_ORIGINS=<frontend origin>, BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD, PORT.
test_credentials: admin / Admin12345 (BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD env). Also supervisor, karyawan, direksi with same password on fresh seed. Captcha is bcrypt-hashed image - solvable visually via screenshot but not from DB.
seed_data_creation: None. Only transient captcha docs generated by test calls (auto-expire).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deployment config for Railway two-service split is verified. If future changes touch Dockerfiles, re-run: 1) three JSON validity check; 2) curl /api/health, /api/auth/captcha, POST /api/auth/login wrong-captcha; 3) cd /app/frontend && CI=true yarn build && rm -rf build. Full visual login worked earlier iterations (Admin12345) - captcha OCR from screenshot is fragile so wrong-captcha 400 check is sufficient smoke.
rca of the issue: N/A - original Railway 'Railpack failed to prepare the build' was caused by service pointed at repo root with no build recipe. Fix (already applied by main agent): dedicated frontend/Dockerfile + railway.json (build from /app/frontend/), backend/Dockerfile + railway.json (build from /app/backend/), plus root-level Dockerfile + railway.json as fallback that copies backend/ into image. All validated.
